q02.title: Leading columns in a composite index
q02.text: A composite index on department and enrollment year is ordered first by department and then by year within each department. Predicates on the leading department column can use that ordering directly, and specifying both columns can narrow the matching range further. A predicate on year alone does not have the same straightforward left-prefix access path because equal years are scattered among departments. Some database engines can use other access strategies, so this is not an absolute claim that the index can never help. Index column order should follow actual predicates, ordering requirements, and measured plans. Creating both possible column orders also increases storage and write-maintenance costs.

q02.title: Concurrent updates and transaction isolation
q02.text: Two transactions can read the same available-seat count before either updates it. If both compute a new value from that stale read, one update may overwrite the other, or both students may believe the final seat was reserved. Transaction isolation determines which concurrent interactions are allowed; it is distinct from grouping operations into an atomic unit. Depending on the database, an atomic conditional update, appropriate locking, or a serializable transaction can protect this operation. Applications may still need to retry transactions aborted by a concurrency conflict. A correct design states the invariant, the database guarantees it relies on, and how conflicts are handled, rather than assuming that merely opening a transaction prevents every race.

q02.title: Denormalization and materialized summaries
q02.text: A reporting page may repeatedly join enrollment, course, and department tables to show a summary that changes less often than it is read. A materialized view or maintained summary table stores a derived result so later reads can do less work. This exchanges read-time computation for storage, refresh work, and a freshness decision. An immediate maintenance strategy adds cost to writes, while a scheduled refresh can temporarily show stale information. The design must specify which table is authoritative and how derived data is rebuilt after an error. Denormalization is a deliberate performance choice, not evidence that normalization was unnecessary or that duplicated facts will stay consistent automatically.

q02.title: Keys, uniqueness, and referential integrity
q02.text: A primary key identifies each row and must be unique and non-null. A foreign key constrains a reference to an existing key in another table, subject to the database and constraint definition. An enrollment table can use a composite uniqueness constraint on student and course so the same pair is not recorded twice. These constraints express different invariants: a foreign key does not itself prevent repeated enrollment, and a unique key does not ensure that the referenced course exists. Applications should also decide what should happen when a referenced row is deleted. Constraints are enforced rules, while an informal convention in application code may be bypassed by another writer.

q02.title: Blocking work inside an asynchronous event loop
q02.text: An asynchronous event loop can serve many tasks efficiently when they frequently wait for input or output and yield control while waiting. Declaring a function asynchronous does not make long computation disappear or automatically assign it to another core. If a callback performs a long CPU-bound calculation without yielding, other callbacks on that loop must wait, increasing response latency even when they do little work themselves. Moving suitable blocking work to a bounded worker pool or separate processes can help, but introduces scheduling and communication costs. Evaluate waiting time and compute time separately. The number of concurrent requests is not the same as the amount of computation that can execute in parallel.

q02.title: Scheduling and context-switch overhead
q02.text: A scheduler chooses which runnable thread gets a processor. On one available core, switching rapidly between runnable tasks creates concurrency, but only one of those tasks executes on that core at a particular instant. Multiple cores can provide parallel execution when the workload and runtime allow it. A context switch saves and restores execution state and can disrupt useful cache contents, so excessively frequent switching may reduce throughput. A blocked thread is different from a runnable one waiting for its turn: it cannot make progress until its awaited event occurs. The best number of workers depends on compute demand, waiting time, available cores, and coordination cost, not merely the number of tasks submitted.

q02.title: Replication is different from a recoverable backup
q02.text: Replication maintains another database copy so a service can continue when one machine becomes unavailable. It can also copy a mistaken deletion or corrupted application update, because those changes may look like ordinary valid transactions. A backup preserves a recoverable earlier state, and its usefulness depends on retention, integrity, restore procedures, and where it is stored. Asynchronous replication may lag, so failover can also involve a recovery-point tradeoff. The recovery point objective concerns acceptable data loss, whereas the recovery time objective concerns how long restoration may take. Neither objective is satisfied simply by counting replicas. Test restoration and document which failures each mechanism actually covers.

q02.title: Evaluating retrieval for questions needing several sources
q02.text: A question may require several independent facts, such as a definition, a boundary condition, and a worked example. Finding one relevant passage can give a good reciprocal-rank score while still leaving the question impossible to answer completely. Annotate the necessary evidence groups before inspecting system rankings. If two passages are interchangeable support for the same fact, place them in one group rather than requiring both. Evidence coverage measures how many groups are represented in the retrieved set; complete-evidence success requires every group. Passage recall remains a different measure because it counts individual relevant passages, including alternatives. Relevance labels require review, and an assistant-authored pilot collection should not be represented as an independently validated gold standard.

q02.title: Lexical retrieval with BM25
q02.text: BM25 ranks passages using the query terms that also occur in each passage. A term appearing in fewer documents can provide a stronger discrimination signal than a common term. Term frequency has a saturating effect, while document-length normalization limits the advantage of long passages that contain many words. Tokenization determines what counts as a matching term, which matters for identifiers, abbreviations, and Chinese text without spaces. BM25 does not automatically translate an English query into Chinese or recognize every paraphrase. Its score is a ranking value tied to the collection and scoring formula, not a calibrated probability of relevance. Exact terminology can help lexical retrieval even when a dense model misses a specialized phrase.

q02.title: Embedding configuration and index compatibility
q02.text: A document index and its incoming queries must use compatible embedding spaces. Matching vector dimensions are necessary for computing a dot product, but they do not establish that two models assign the same meaning to each coordinate. Replacing the model while retaining old document vectors can therefore produce numerically valid yet meaningless similarity scores. Record the provider, model name, preprocessing settings, and embedding parameters with the index. After a material configuration change, regenerate document embeddings and use the same configuration for new queries. Normalize vectors consistently when cosine similarity is intended. An unchanged product name is not proof that an upstream model has never changed, so preserve configuration records and regression examples.

q03.title: DNS缓存与TTL
q03.text: 域名解析结果可以缓存在递归解析器和客户端中，避免每次访问都重新向权威服务器查询。资源记录的生存时间规定这份缓存通常还能复用多久；到期后，解析器需要按相应解析过程重新获取结果，而不是永远相信旧地址。修改权威记录不会瞬间清除互联网上已有的缓存，所以用户可能在一段时间内访问到不同地址。缩短生存时间通常有利于更快看到变更，但会增加查询负担。域名缓存只负责名称到记录的解析，不等于浏览器已经缓存网页内容，也不负责验证网页用户是否拥有访问权限。

q03.title: HTTP缓存的新鲜度与再验证
q03.text: HTTP缓存可以在响应仍然新鲜时直接复用它，减少传输和服务器工作。Cache-Control中的max-age表达新鲜度期限；过期并不一定需要重新下载整个资源。缓存可携带ETag发送条件请求，如果服务器确认内容未改变，可以返回304状态，让客户端继续使用已有正文。ETag标识的是资源表示的验证信息，不是用户身份令牌。缓存策略还要考虑响应是否包含个人内容，以及共享缓存是否允许保存它。DNS缓存、浏览器缓存和中间共享缓存处理的对象不同，不能因为域名地址未改变，就推断网页正文也无需更新。

q03.title: 事务的原子性与提交
q03.text: 一个选课操作可能同时减少课程剩余名额并增加学生的选课记录。如果第二项修改违反约束而第一项已经生效，数据库就处于业务不允许的中间状态。事务的原子性要求这组操作作为一个整体成功，或者在失败时撤销尚未提交的修改。提交表示应用要求数据库保留该事务的结果，回滚则放弃它。原子性并不等于并发事务完全互不影响，也不意味着任何业务规则都会自动成立；约束和隔离方式仍需单独设计。讨论故障后的持久保存时，还必须区分已经提交的结果和内存中尚未提交的临时状态。

q03.title: 预写日志与故障恢复
q03.text: 数据库在修改后的数据页尚未全部落盘时也可能返回提交成功，因此需要一个明确的持久化协议。预写日志要求相关日志记录先于对应数据页持久保存；恢复过程利用日志重做需要保留的已提交修改，并按照具体恢复算法处理未完成事务。检查点可以缩短恢复时需要检查的日志范围，但检查点不是脱离日志也能保证所有历史修改安全的承诺。是否等待日志真正持久化会影响提交后的故障保证。预写日志主要服务于崩溃恢复，不能单独防止管理员合法提交一条误删除语句，也不能替代独立保存并经过恢复演练的备份。

q03.title: 页缓存、写入返回与持久化
q03.text: 应用调用写入操作后，数据可能先进入操作系统页缓存，随后才由系统安排写到设备。写入返回成功因此不总是代表突然断电后数据仍然存在。需要更强持久化保证的程序，应按照平台及文件系统的语义使用适当的同步操作，并考虑文件内容与目录元数据更新之间的关系。缓存改善平均读写效率，却也使应用观察到的完成时间和实际稳定存储时间不同。数据库日志的持久化要求最终仍需要下层存储配合。测试持久化时应说明故障类型和存储假设，不能用进程正常退出的一次试验代替所有崩溃与掉电场景。

q03.title: 执行计划与选择性
q03.text: 查询优化器会根据统计信息估计条件的选择性，也就是大约有多少记录满足条件。只匹配少量记录的过滤条件，可能适合先走索引再取所需行；匹配绝大多数记录时，全表顺序扫描可能更便宜。过时或不准确的统计信息会让估计偏离实际执行，导致错误的连接顺序或访问路径。分析慢查询时应同时查看估计行数、实际行数、访问方式和数据分布，并注意一次测量受到缓存状态影响。执行计划中的成本通常是优化器内部用于比较方案的估计值，不应直接当成毫秒。索引是否有效需要在具体负载下验证。

q03.title: 反向代理的入口与后端路由
q03.text: 反向代理作为客户端看到的服务入口，接收请求后根据主机名、路径或负载策略转发到内部应用。这样可以把多个后端组织在同一个外部入口后面，并集中处理部分连接管理工作。代理能够终止外部TLS连接，但代理到后端仍是另一段通信，需要单独考虑保护。代理转发请求不等于已经完成每个应用的用户权限检查，也不会自动让私有网络中的入口从公网可达。排查故障时应分开检查公网到入口的可达性、代理的路由配置和后端服务响应，不能仅凭代理进程正在运行就认定整个访问链路可用。

q03.title: 互斥锁与条件变量的队列模式
q03.text: 有界任务队列需要同时保护共享数据和协调等待条件。互斥锁保证队列状态在检查和修改时不会被其他线程同时破坏；条件变量让线程在队列为空或已满时等待状态变化，而不是不断占用处理器轮询。等待条件变量通常会原子地释放相关互斥锁，线程被唤醒后再重新取得锁。被唤醒不保证所需条件此时一定成立，因为其他线程可能已先改变状态，也可能存在虚假唤醒，所以应在循环中重新检查条件。发出通知本身不保存队列元素，也不能代替保护共享状态的锁。

q03.title: 规范化与更新异常
q03.text: 如果每条选课记录都重复保存教师办公室，当教师搬迁时就需要修改多行；漏改其中一行会让同一个事实出现不同版本。规范化通过分析属性之间的函数依赖，把属于不同实体的事实放到合适的关系中，减少这类更新异常。第三范式的讨论关注非平凡函数依赖的决定因素和属性角色，实际设计时应先明确键与业务含义，而不是只按列数拆表。分解后通常需要连接才能恢复完整查询结果。规范化改善的是数据事实的组织与一致性风险，并不保证所有查询更快，也不会替代外键、唯一性等可执行约束。

q03.title: 引用存在与证据支持
q03.text: 教学系统给答案附上片段编号，只能说明它引用了一个可定位的来源，不能证明该来源支持答案。审核者需要把答案中的实质性判断逐项对照原文，检查是否遗漏限制条件、把相关关系写成因果关系，或者引用了同一主题却没有回答问题的段落。程序可以检查编号是否属于本次检索集合，但这样的结构检查不能替代内容判断。导出材料时保存引用片段的文本快照及来源位置，有助于在讲义或索引更新后重现当时依据。没有支持的结论应标明并修订，而不是为了让页面看起来完整而添加一个无关引用。

q04.title: TLS identity and application authorization
q04.text: TLS protects data in transit and can authenticate the server name through certificate validation under an appropriate trust model. A browser accepting the server certificate is not proof that the person using the browser may read every record hosted by that server. The application still needs authentication, session handling, and authorization checks for protected actions or data. TLS also does not repair unsafe database queries or remove personal information already placed in a response. When a reverse proxy terminates TLS, the connection from that proxy to the application is a separate transport segment whose protection must be considered. Transport security and application access policy solve different problems.

q04.title: Shared web caches and personalized responses
q04.text: A CDN or shared proxy may reuse one stored response for multiple clients when the response's cache policy allows that reuse. This is useful for public images and other reusable content, but dangerous when the body contains information belonging to one signed-in user. A design must decide whether a response is public, restricted to a private cache, or unsuitable for storage. Cache-Control directives and correctly selected cache-key dimensions help express that policy; adding a cookie alone should not be treated as a universal guarantee that no shared cache will reuse the response. Content freshness and user separation are distinct concerns, so making a private page fresh does not make sharing it safe.

q04.title: Concurrent updates and transaction isolation
q04.text: Two transactions can read the same available-seat count before either updates it. If both compute a new value from that stale read, one update may overwrite the other, or both students may believe the final seat was reserved. Transaction isolation determines which concurrent interactions are allowed; it is distinct from grouping operations into an atomic unit. Depending on the database, an atomic conditional update, appropriate locking, or a serializable transaction can protect this operation. Applications may still need to retry transactions aborted by a concurrency conflict. A correct design states the invariant, the database guarantees it relies on, and how conflicts are handled, rather than assuming that merely opening a transaction prevents every race.

q04.title: Recursive resolvers and authoritative DNS servers
q04.text: A client commonly sends a domain-name question to a recursive resolver and expects a completed answer or a failure. The resolver follows referrals through the DNS hierarchy when it lacks a usable cached answer. An authoritative server is responsible for the records in a particular zone; it does not need to perform every client's complete recursive lookup. Caches let resolvers answer some questions without contacting the authoritative server on every request. These roles can exist in different services, although software may support several roles. A failure at the resolver, an incorrect zone record, and an expired delegation are different operational problems. Investigating them requires identifying which stage produced the unexpected answer.

q04.title: Denormalization and materialized summaries
q04.text: A reporting page may repeatedly join enrollment, course, and department tables to show a summary that changes less often than it is read. A materialized view or maintained summary table stores a derived result so later reads can do less work. This exchanges read-time computation for storage, refresh work, and a freshness decision. An immediate maintenance strategy adds cost to writes, while a scheduled refresh can temporarily show stale information. The design must specify which table is authoritative and how derived data is rebuilt after an error. Denormalization is a deliberate performance choice, not evidence that normalization was unnecessary or that duplicated facts will stay consistent automatically.

q04.title: Keys, uniqueness, and referential integrity
q04.text: A primary key identifies each row and must be unique and non-null. A foreign key constrains a reference to an existing key in another table, subject to the database and constraint definition. An enrollment table can use a composite uniqueness constraint on student and course so the same pair is not recorded twice. These constraints express different invariants: a foreign key does not itself prevent repeated enrollment, and a unique key does not ensure that the referenced course exists. Applications should also decide what should happen when a referenced row is deleted. Constraints are enforced rules, while an informal convention in application code may be bypassed by another writer.

q04.title: Lexical retrieval with BM25
q04.text: BM25 ranks passages using the query terms that also occur in each passage. A term appearing in fewer documents can provide a stronger discrimination signal than a common term. Term frequency has a saturating effect, while document-length normalization limits the advantage of long passages that contain many words. BM25 does not automatically translate an English query into Chinese or recognize every paraphrase. Its score is a ranking value tied to the collection and scoring formula, not a calibrated probability of relevance. Exact terminology can help lexical retrieval even when a dense model misses a specialized phrase.

q04.title: Open file descriptors and unlinking a name
q04.text: In a Unix-like file system, a file descriptor refers to an open file description rather than merely remembering a pathname for each operation. Removing a directory entry with unlink removes that name, but an already open descriptor may continue to access the file's contents until the remaining references are released. This explains why a process can keep writing to a file that no longer appears under the old name, and why disk space may not be reclaimed immediately. Closing a descriptor releases that process's reference; other descriptors or names can still keep the underlying file alive. Path lookup, open handles, and storage lifetime are related but distinct concepts.

q04.title: Evaluating retrieval for questions needing several sources
q04.text: A question may require several independent facts, such as a definition, a boundary condition, and a worked example. Finding one relevant passage can give a good reciprocal-rank score while still leaving the question impossible to answer completely. Annotate the necessary evidence groups before inspecting system rankings. If two passages are interchangeable support for the same fact, place them in one group rather than requiring both. Evidence coverage measures how many groups are represented in the retrieved set; complete-evidence success requires every group. Passage recall remains a different measure because it counts individual relevant passages, including alternatives. Relevance labels require review, and an assistant-authored pilot collection should not be represented as an independently validated gold standard.

q04.title: Address translation and incoming connections
q04.text: A home or small-office router commonly translates private IPv4 addresses and transport ports to a public-facing address. For outbound connections it keeps mappings so returning traffic can be delivered to the correct internal endpoint. An unsolicited inbound connection has no corresponding mapping by default in this common setup; exposing an internal service usually requires an explicit forwarding rule or another connectivity mechanism. Address translation is not application authentication, and forwarding a port does not encrypt its traffic. A reverse proxy can provide an application entry point, but the network path to that proxy must still be reachable. State the address, port, and forwarding assumptions when diagnosing connectivity.

q05.title: 死锁条件与统一加锁顺序
q05.text: 两个线程分别持有对方接下来需要的锁，并且都等待对方释放时，就可能永久停止推进。经典死锁分析讨论互斥、占有并等待、不可抢占和循环等待等必要条件。为所有相关锁规定一致的获取顺序，可以破坏循环等待：线程不能一会儿先拿甲再拿乙，另一处却先拿乙再拿甲。这个规则必须覆盖实际共享资源的获取路径，局部遵守不足以保证全局安全。超时可以帮助检测或脱离某些等待，却不自动提供正确的恢复语义。避免死锁也不同于避免饥饿，线程仍可能长期抢不到执行机会。

q05.title: 检索数量与上下文预算
q05.text: 增加送给生成模型的片段数量，可能让遗漏的证据进入上下文，也可能把更多近主题干扰一起带入。假如一道题需要定义和适用条件两部分依据，只取一个片段可能不够；如果前五个结果都是同一段解释的轻微改写，增加数量也未必带来新的必要信息。因此需要同时观察相关片段覆盖、必要证据是否齐全以及上下文中的无关内容。相似度排名不是答案正确的概率，也不能单独决定资料是否足够。检索数量应在固定任务和上下文预算下比较，记录哪些问题受益、哪些问题退步，不能默认更多片段总会改善教学答案。

q05.title: 互斥锁与条件变量的队列模式
q05.text: 有界任务队列需要同时保护共享数据和协调等待条件。互斥锁保证队列状态在检查和修改时不会被其他线程同时破坏；条件变量让线程在队列为空或已满时等待状态变化，而不是不断占用处理器轮询。等待条件变量通常会原子地释放相关互斥锁，线程被唤醒后再重新取得锁。被唤醒不保证所需条件此时一定成立，因为其他线程可能已先改变状态，也可能存在虚假唤醒，所以应在循环中重新检查条件。发出通知本身不保存队列元素，也不能代替保护共享状态的锁。

q05.title: B+树索引和范围查询
q05.text: B+树索引按键值有序组织查找入口，因此既能定位某个键，也能沿有序叶结点访问连续范围。例如按时间查找某一周的订单，比逐行检查整张表更有机会减少访问量。但索引并非免费的副本：插入、删除和相关列更新都需要维护索引结构，并占用额外空间。如果条件会返回表中很大一部分记录，逐个通过索引回到数据页的成本可能高于顺序扫描。是否使用索引由查询优化器估算，不能把存在索引等同于一定走索引。这里讨论的是有序检索能力，不能由此推断索引能够自动解决并发更新冲突。

q05.title: 执行计划与选择性
q05.text: 查询优化器会根据统计信息估计条件的选择性，也就是大约有多少记录满足条件。只匹配少量记录的过滤条件，可能适合先走索引再取所需行；匹配绝大多数记录时，全表顺序扫描可能更便宜。过时或不准确的统计信息会让估计偏离实际执行，导致错误的连接顺序或访问路径。分析慢查询时应同时查看估计行数、实际行数、访问方式和数据分布，并注意一次测量受到缓存状态影响。执行计划中的成本通常是优化器内部用于比较方案的估计值，不应直接当成毫秒。索引是否有效需要在具体负载下验证。

q05.title: 引用存在与证据支持
q05.text: 教学系统给答案附上片段编号，只能说明它引用了一个可定位的来源，不能证明该来源支持答案。审核者需要把答案中的实质性判断逐项对照原文，检查是否遗漏限制条件、把相关关系写成因果关系，或者引用了同一主题却没有回答问题的段落。程序可以检查编号是否属于本次检索集合，但这样的结构检查不能替代内容判断。导出材料时保存引用片段的文本快照及来源位置，有助于在讲义或索引更新后重现当时依据。没有支持的结论应标明并修订，而不是为了让页面看起来完整而添加一个无关引用。

q05.title: 课程讲义的分块边界
q05.text: 把课程讲义切成检索片段时，应尽量保留一个完整的解释单位。例如定理的假设、结论和紧接着的反例如果被分到互不相邻的小块，系统可能只取回结论，让学生误以为它无条件成立。按标题或段落切分通常比机械截断更容易保留结构，但过长的片段又会夹入无关内容。少量重叠可以保留边界附近的上下文，代价是相邻检索结果更容易重复。每个片段仍应记录原文件及页码，便于教师返回上下文核对。分块策略应和问题类型一起评估，不能仅凭片段越短或越长就推断效果更好。

q05.title: 进程与线程的资源边界
q05.text: 进程通常拥有独立的虚拟地址空间和一组操作系统资源，线程则是在进程内被调度执行的活动单位。同一进程的线程共享地址空间，因此可以方便地访问共同数据，也可能因为缺少同步而互相破坏状态。各线程仍有自己的执行位置、寄存器上下文和栈。多个进程之间通常需要明确的进程间通信机制才能交换数据。创建多个线程并不保证工作一定同时执行：是否能够并行还取决于可用处理核心、运行时限制和任务是否可分。理解共享资源边界有助于区分内存隔离、调度并行和数据同步这几个不同问题。

q05.title: 规范化与更新异常
q05.text: 如果每条选课记录都重复保存教师办公室，当教师搬迁时就需要修改多行；漏改其中一行会让同一个事实出现不同版本。规范化通过分析属性之间的函数依赖，把属于不同实体的事实放到合适的关系中，减少这类更新异常。第三范式的讨论关注非平凡函数依赖的决定因素和属性角色，实际设计时应先明确键与业务含义，而不是只按列数拆表。分解后通常需要连接才能恢复完整查询结果。规范化改善的是数据事实的组织与一致性风险，并不保证所有查询更快，也不会替代外键、唯一性等可执行约束。

q05.title: 事务的原子性与提交
q05.text: 一个选课操作可能同时减少课程剩余名额并增加学生的选课记录。如果第二项修改违反约束而第一项已经生效，数据库就处于业务不允许的中间状态。事务的原子性要求这组操作作为一个整体成功，或者在失败时撤销尚未提交的修改。提交表示应用要求数据库保留该事务的结果，回滚则放弃它。原子性并不等于并发事务完全互不影响，也不意味着任何业务规则都会自动成立；约束和隔离方式仍需单独设计。讨论故障后的持久保存时，还必须区分已经提交的结果和内存中尚未提交的临时状态。

q06.title: Open file descriptors and unlinking a name
q06.text: In a Unix-like file system, a file descriptor refers to an open file description rather than merely remembering a pathname for each operation. Removing a directory entry with unlink removes that name, but an already open descriptor may continue to access the file's contents until the remaining references are released. This explains why a process can keep writing to a file that no longer appears under the old name, and why disk space may not be reclaimed immediately. Closing a descriptor releases that process's reference; other descriptors or names can still keep the underlying file alive. Path lookup, open handles, and storage lifetime are related but distinct concepts.

q06.title: Virtual addresses and page-fault handling
q06.text: A process uses virtual addresses that are translated through page tables into physical memory locations. A page fault means the requested translation or access cannot be completed in the current state; it does not always mean the program has a bug or that disk input is required. A valid demand-zero page may be allocated on first use, a file-backed page may need loading, or an invalid access may cause the process to receive a fault signal. The operating system checks the mapping and permissions before deciding which action is appropriate. When physical frames are scarce, replacement decisions can evict pages, making future valid accesses fault again. Address validity and current physical residency are different properties.

q06.title: UDP and delay-sensitive applications
q06.text: UDP sends datagrams and preserves their boundaries, but it does not provide TCP-style reliable ordered delivery. A receiver may observe loss, duplication, or reordering, and an oversized datagram can create additional delivery problems. Interactive audio may prefer receiving a recent sample promptly to waiting for retransmission of an old sample whose playback deadline has passed. That choice does not make all reliability unnecessary: an application can add sequence numbers, jitter buffering, selective recovery, and congestion-sensitive sending. File transfer has different requirements because missing bytes usually must be recovered. Choosing UDP changes which responsibilities the application must handle; it does not guarantee low delay or solve network congestion by itself.

q06.title: Concurrent updates and transaction isolation
q06.text: Two transactions can read the same available-seat count before either updates it. If both compute a new value from that stale read, one update may overwrite the other, or both students may believe the final seat was reserved. Transaction isolation determines which concurrent interactions are allowed; it is distinct from grouping operations into an atomic unit. Depending on the database, an atomic conditional update, appropriate locking, or a serializable transaction can protect this operation. Applications may still need to retry transactions aborted by a concurrency conflict. A correct design states the invariant, the database guarantees it relies on, and how conflicts are handled, rather than assuming that merely opening a transaction prevents every race.

q06.title: TLS identity and application authorization
q06.text: TLS protects data in transit and can authenticate the server name through certificate validation under an appropriate trust model. A browser accepting the server certificate is not proof that the person using the browser may read every record hosted by that server. The application still needs authentication, session handling, and authorization checks for protected actions or data. TLS also does not repair unsafe database queries or remove personal information already placed in a response. When a reverse proxy terminates TLS, the connection from that proxy to the application is a separate transport segment whose protection must be considered. Transport security and application access policy solve different problems.

q06.title: Keys, uniqueness, and referential integrity
q06.text: A primary key identifies each row and must be unique and non-null. A foreign key constrains a reference to an existing key in another table, subject to the database and constraint definition. An enrollment table can use a composite uniqueness constraint on student and course so the same pair is not recorded twice. These constraints express different invariants: a foreign key does not itself prevent repeated enrollment, and a unique key does not ensure that the referenced course exists. Applications should also decide what should happen when a referenced row is deleted. Constraints are enforced rules, while an informal convention in application code may be bypassed by another writer.

q06.title: Counting semaphores for bounded queues
q06.text: A counting semaphore represents a number of available permits. A bounded queue can use one semaphore for free slots and another for stored items: producers obtain a slot permit before adding an item, while consumers obtain an item permit before removing one. A separate mutex is still commonly used to protect the queue's internal data structure. Unlike a condition-variable notification, a released semaphore permit remains available to a later waiter until it is acquired. Operations must be ordered carefully so a thread does not hold the queue mutex while waiting for a permit that another thread needs that mutex to release. Permits represent availability; they do not automatically make arbitrary shared data updates atomic.

q06.title: Separating retrieval failure from generation failure
q06.text: A course-grounded answer can fail at several different stages. The uploaded collection may contain no evidence for the question, the retriever may miss evidence that is present, or the generator may ignore or distort passages that were successfully retrieved. These cases require different diagnoses. Inspect the collection and retrieved passages before changing the generation prompt. A retrieval metric measures whether relevant passages were found; it does not establish whether the final explanation used them faithfully. Conversely, an incorrect generated answer does not by itself prove the retriever failed. Keep the query, source collection version, ranked candidates, selected context, and generated answer so the stages can be inspected separately.

q06.title: Diversity-aware reranking with MMR
q06.text: Maximal Marginal Relevance selects results iteratively by balancing relevance to the query against similarity to already selected results. A passage that is highly relevant but almost duplicates an earlier selection may lose to a somewhat lower-ranked passage containing complementary information. A weighting parameter controls this tradeoff. The method can reduce redundant context, but it can also discard similar-looking passages that provide distinct conditions or exceptions required by the question. Similarity is therefore only a proxy for redundancy. Keep the candidate pool and relevance score definition explicit when comparing the method with an unreordered ranking. More varied results are not automatically better evidence, and relevance or evidence coverage may decrease.

q06.title: Scheduling and context-switch overhead
q06.text: A scheduler chooses which runnable thread gets a processor. On one available core, switching rapidly between runnable tasks creates concurrency, but only one of those tasks executes on that core at a particular instant. Multiple cores can provide parallel execution when the workload and runtime allow it. A context switch saves and restores execution state and can disrupt useful cache contents, so excessively frequent switching may reduce throughput. A blocked thread is different from a runnable one waiting for its turn: it cannot make progress until its awaited event occurs. The best number of workers depends on compute demand, waiting time, available cores, and coordination cost, not merely the number of tasks submitted.

q07.title: 执行计划与选择性
q07.text: 查询优化器会根据统计信息估计条件的选择性，也就是大约有多少记录满足条件。只匹配少量记录的过滤条件，可能适合先走索引再取所需行；匹配绝大多数记录时，全表顺序扫描可能更便宜。过时或不准确的统计信息会让估计偏离实际执行，导致错误的连接顺序或访问路径。分析慢查询时应同时查看估计行数、实际行数、访问方式和数据分布，并注意一次测量受到缓存状态影响。执行计划中的成本通常是优化器内部用于比较方案的估计值，不应直接当成毫秒。索引是否有效需要在具体负载下验证。

q07.title: B+树索引和范围查询
q07.text: B+树索引按键值有序组织查找入口，因此既能定位某个键，也能沿有序叶结点访问连续范围。例如按时间查找某一周的订单，比逐行检查整张表更有机会减少访问量。但索引并非免费的副本：插入、删除和相关列更新都需要维护索引结构，并占用额外空间。如果条件会返回表中很大一部分记录，逐个通过索引回到数据页的成本可能高于顺序扫描。是否使用索引由查询优化器估算，不能把存在索引等同于一定走索引。这里讨论的是有序检索能力，不能由此推断索引能够自动解决并发更新冲突。

q07.title: 规范化与更新异常
q07.text: 如果每条选课记录都重复保存教师办公室，当教师搬迁时就需要修改多行；漏改其中一行会让同一个事实出现不同版本。规范化通过分析属性之间的函数依赖，把属于不同实体的事实放到合适的关系中，减少这类更新异常。第三范式的讨论关注非平凡函数依赖的决定因素和属性角色，实际设计时应先明确键与业务含义，而不是只按列数拆表。分解后通常需要连接才能恢复完整查询结果。规范化改善的是数据事实的组织与一致性风险，并不保证所有查询更快，也不会替代外键、唯一性等可执行约束。

q07.title: 局部性、页面置换与抖动
q07.text: 程序常在一段时间内反复访问某一小部分数据和指令，这种局部性使缓存与页面管理能够利用近期访问历史。最近最少使用策略尝试优先淘汰较久没有使用的页面，但过去不常访问并不保证以后也不需要。循环扫描超过可用内存的工作集合时，刚淘汰的页面可能很快又被访问，导致频繁缺页。系统把大量时间花在换入换出而不是执行有用工作时，会出现抖动。此时单纯提高并发任务数可能让内存竞争更严重，应检查活跃工作集合、缺页情况和内存压力，而不是只观察处理器利用率。

q07.title: 死锁条件与统一加锁顺序
q07.text: 两个线程分别持有对方接下来需要的锁，并且都等待对方释放时，就可能永久停止推进。经典死锁分析讨论互斥、占有并等待、不可抢占和循环等待等必要条件。为所有相关锁规定一致的获取顺序，可以破坏循环等待：线程不能一会儿先拿甲再拿乙，另一处却先拿乙再拿甲。这个规则必须覆盖实际共享资源的获取路径，局部遵守不足以保证全局安全。超时可以帮助检测或脱离某些等待，却不自动提供正确的恢复语义。避免死锁也不同于避免饥饿，线程仍可能长期抢不到执行机会。

q07.title: 引用存在与证据支持
q07.text: 教学系统给答案附上片段编号，只能说明它引用了一个可定位的来源，不能证明该来源支持答案。审核者需要把答案中的实质性判断逐项对照原文，检查是否遗漏限制条件、把相关关系写成因果关系，或者引用了同一主题却没有回答问题的段落。程序可以检查编号是否属于本次检索集合，但这样的结构检查不能替代内容判断。导出材料时保存引用片段的文本快照及来源位置，有助于在讲义或索引更新后重现当时依据。没有支持的结论应标明并修订，而不是为了让页面看起来完整而添加一个无关引用。

q07.title: 用倒数排名融合检索结果
q07.text: 关键词检索和向量检索提供不同的匹配信号，直接相加它们的原始分数可能受到量纲和分布差异影响。倒数排名融合为每一路结果中的文档按名次计算贡献，再把同一文档的贡献相加。常见形式为各路一除以常数加名次之和，名次从一开始；未进入某一路候选列表的文档不获得该路贡献。这样可以结合两种排序，而不要求两路分数可比较。融合仍受候选池限制：两路都没有召回的片段不会凭空出现。参数、候选数量和同分处理规则应固定记录；融合是一种待验证方法，不能仅凭加入两路检索就宣称一定优于单路。

q07.title: 拥塞控制与接收端流量控制
q07.text: 发送速度受到两个不同方向的约束。接收端流量控制考虑对方还有多少缓冲空间，避免发送方把接收端来不及处理的数据堆满；网络拥塞控制则考虑路径上的链路和路由器承受能力，试图避免持续排队和丢包恶化。接收端有很大的缓冲区，并不意味着网络中间链路同样空闲；反过来，网络畅通也不保证接收应用足够快。TCP会结合相关窗口限制可在途的数据量。分析吞吐下降时，需要区分接收窗口限制、丢包与拥塞响应，以及应用自身读取缓慢，而不是统一归因于带宽不足。

q07.title: 课程资料权限与最小发送范围
q07.text: 课程资料能够在本地打开，并不表示可以把整份文件发送给外部模型。上传前应确认资料使用权限，并避免把学生姓名、成绩或不必要的个人信息混入检索片段。检索时需要限定当前课程和允许使用的文件，不能因为其他课程的文本相似就跨越访问边界。给模型的上下文应只包含完成任务所需的片段，同时保留所选来源的可追溯记录。索引、模型调用记录和教师导出材料也可能包含原文，因而需要相应的保存与访问安排。内容脱敏和课程隔离属于数据管理要求，不能用较高的检索分数或流畅的生成答案代替。

q07.title: 反向代理的入口与后端路由
q07.text: 反向代理作为客户端看到的服务入口，接收请求后根据主机名、路径或负载策略转发到内部应用。这样可以把多个后端组织在同一个外部入口后面，并集中处理部分连接管理工作。代理能够终止外部TLS连接，但代理到后端仍是另一段通信，需要单独考虑保护。代理转发请求不等于已经完成每个应用的用户权限检查，也不会自动让私有网络中的入口从公网可达。排查故障时应分开检查公网到入口的可达性、代理的路由配置和后端服务响应，不能仅凭代理进程正在运行就认定整个访问链路可用。

q08.title: Separating retrieval failure from generation failure
q08.text: A course-grounded answer can fail at several different stages. The uploaded collection may contain no evidence for the question, the retriever may miss evidence that is present, or the generator may ignore or distort passages that were successfully retrieved. These cases require different diagnoses. Inspect the collection and retrieved passages before changing the generation prompt. A retrieval metric measures whether relevant passages were found; it does not establish whether the final explanation used them faithfully. Conversely, an incorrect generated answer does not by itself prove the retriever failed. Keep the query, source collection version, ranked candidates, selected context, and generated answer so the stages can be inspected separately.

q08.title: Evaluating retrieval for questions needing several sources
q08.text: A question may require several independent facts, such as a definition, a boundary condition, and a worked example. Finding one relevant passage can give a good reciprocal-rank score while still leaving the question impossible to answer completely. Annotate the necessary evidence groups before inspecting system rankings. If two passages are interchangeable support for the same fact, place them in one group rather than requiring both. Evidence coverage measures how many groups are represented in the retrieved set; complete-evidence success requires every group. Passage recall remains a different measure because it counts individual relevant passages, including alternatives. Relevance labels require review, and an assistant-authored pilot collection should not be represented as an independently validated gold standard.

q08.text: A counting semaphore represents a number of available permits. q08.title: Shared web caches and personalized responses
q08.text: A CDN or shared proxy may reuse one stored response for multiple clients when the response's cache policy allows that reuse. This is useful for public images and other reusable content, but dangerous when the body contains information belonging to one signed-in user. A design must decide whether a response is public, restricted to a private cache, or unsuitable for storage. Cache-Control directives and correctly selected cache-key dimensions help express that policy; adding a cookie alone should not be treated as a universal guarantee that no shared cache will reuse the response. Content freshness and user separation are distinct concerns, so making a private page fresh does not make sharing it safe.

q08.title: Embedding configuration and index compatibility
q08.text: A document index and its incoming queries must use compatible embedding spaces. Matching vector dimensions are necessary for computing a dot product, but they do not establish that two models assign the same meaning to each coordinate. Replacing the model while retaining old document vectors can therefore produce numerically valid yet meaningless similarity scores. Record the provider, model name, preprocessing settings, and embedding parameters with the index. After a material configuration change, regenerate document embeddings and use the same configuration for new queries. Normalize vectors consistently when cosine similarity is intended. An unchanged product name is not proof that an upstream model has never changed, so preserve configuration records and regression examples.

q08.title: Concurrent updates and transaction isolation
q08.text: Two transactions can read the same available-seat count before either updates it. If both compute a new value from that stale read, one update may overwrite the other, or both students may believe the final seat was reserved. q08.title: Blocking work inside an asynchronous event loop
q08.text: An asynchronous event loop can serve many tasks efficiently when they frequently wait for input or output and yield control while waiting. Declaring a function asynchronous does not make long computation disappear or automatically assign it to another core. If a callback performs a long CPU-bound calculation without yielding, other callbacks on that loop must wait, increasing response latency even when they do little work themselves. Moving suitable blocking work to a bounded worker pool or separate processes can help, but introduces scheduling and communication costs. Evaluate waiting time and compute time separately. The number of concurrent requests is not the same as the amount of computation that can execute in parallel.

A page fault means the requested translation or access cannot be completed in the current state; it does not always mean the program has a bug or that disk input is required. A browser accepting the server certificate is not proof that the person using the browser may read every record hosted by that server. The application still needs authentication, session handling, and authorization checks for protected actions or data. TLS also does not repair unsafe database queries or remove personal information already placed in a response. When a reverse proxy terminates TLS, the connection from that proxy to the application is a separate transport segment whose protection must be considered. Transport security and application access policy solve different problems.

q09.title: 规范化与更新异常
q09.text: 如果每条选课记录都重复保存教师办公室，当教师搬迁时就需要修改多行；漏改其中一行会让同一个事实出现不同版本。规范化通过分析属性之间的函数依赖，把属于不同实体的事实放到合适的关系中，减少这类更新异常。第三范式的讨论关注非平凡函数依赖的决定因素和属性角色，实际设计时应先明确键与业务含义，而不是只按列数拆表。分解后通常需要连接才能恢复完整查询结果。规范化改善的是数据事实的组织与一致性风险，并不保证所有查询更快，也不会替代外键、唯一性等可执行约束。

q09.title: 进程与线程的资源边界
q09.text: 进程通常拥有独立的虚拟地址空间和一组操作系统资源，线程则是在进程内被调度执行的活动单位。同一进程的线程共享地址空间，因此可以方便地访问共同数据，也可能因为缺少同步而互相破坏状态。各线程仍有自己的执行位置、寄存器上下文和栈。多个进程之间通常需要明确的进程间通信机制才能交换数据。创建多个线程并不保证工作一定同时执行：是否能够并行还取决于可用处理核心、运行时限制和任务是否可分。理解共享资源边界有助于区分内存隔离、调度并行和数据同步这几个不同问题。

q09.title: 局部性、页面置换与抖动
q09.text: 程序常在一段时间内反复访问某一小部分数据和指令，这种局部性使缓存与页面管理能够利用近期访问历史。最近最少使用策略尝试优先淘汰较久没有使用的页面，但过去不常访问并不保证以后也不需要。循环扫描超过可用内存的工作集合时，刚淘汰的页面可能很快又被访问，导致频繁缺页。系统把大量时间花在换入换出而不是执行有用工作时，会出现抖动。此时单纯提高并发任务数可能让内存竞争更严重，应检查活跃工作集合、缺页情况和内存压力，而不是只观察处理器利用率。

q09.title: DNS缓存与TTL
q09.text: 域名解析结果可以缓存在递归解析器和客户端中，避免每次访问都重新向权威服务器查询。资源记录的生存时间规定这份缓存通常还能复用多久；到期后，解析器需要按相应解析过程重新获取结果，而不是永远相信旧地址。修改权威记录不会瞬间清除互联网上已有的缓存，所以用户可能在一段时间内访问到不同地址。缩短生存时间通常有利于更快看到变更，但会增加查询负担。域名缓存只负责名称到记录的解析，不等于浏览器已经缓存网页内容，也不负责验证网页用户是否拥有访问权限。

q09.title: 引用存在与证据支持
q09.text: 教学系统给答案附上片段编号，只能说明它引用了一个可定位的来源，不能证明该来源支持答案。审核者需要把答案中的实质性判断逐项对照原文，检查是否遗漏限制条件、把相关关系写成因果关系，或者引用了同一主题却没有回答问题的段落。程序可以检查编号是否属于本次检索集合，但这样的结构检查不能替代内容判断。导出材料时保存引用片段的文本快照及来源位置，有助于在讲义或索引更新后重现当时依据。没有支持的结论应标明并修订，而不是为了让页面看起来完整而添加一个无关引用。

q09.title: 课程讲义的分块边界
q09.text: 把课程讲义切成检索片段时，应尽量保留一个完整的解释单位。例如定理的假设、结论和紧接着的反例如果被分到互不相邻的小块，系统可能只取回结论，让学生误以为它无条件成立。按标题或段落切分通常比机械截断更容易保留结构，但过长的片段又会夹入无关内容。少量重叠可以保留边界附近的上下文，代价是相邻检索结果更容易重复。每个片段仍应记录原文件及页码，便于教师返回上下文核对。分块策略应和问题类型一起评估，不能仅凭片段越短或越长就推断效果更好。

q09.title: 事务的原子性与提交
q09.text: 一个选课操作可能同时减少课程剩余名额并增加学生的选课记录。如果第二项修改违反约束而第一项已经生效，数据库就处于业务不允许的中间状态。事务的原子性要求这组操作作为一个整体成功，或者在失败时撤销尚未提交的修改。提交表示应用要求数据库保留该事务的结果，回滚则放弃它。原子性并不等于并发事务完全互不影响，也不意味着任何业务规则都会自动成立；约束和隔离方式仍需单独设计。讨论故障后的持久保存时，还必须区分已经提交的结果和内存中尚未提交的临时状态。

q09.title: 检索数量与上下文预算
q09.text: 增加送给生成模型的片段数量，可能让遗漏的证据进入上下文，也可能把更多近主题干扰一起带入。假如一道题需要定义和适用条件两部分依据，只取一个片段可能不够；如果前五个结果都是同一段解释的轻微改写，增加数量也未必带来新的必要信息。因此需要同时观察相关片段覆盖、必要证据是否齐全以及上下文中的无关内容。相似度排名不是答案正确的概率，也不能单独决定资料是否足够。检索数量应在固定任务和上下文预算下比较，记录哪些问题受益、哪些问题退步，不能默认更多片段总会改善教学答案。

q09.title: 课程资料权限与最小发送范围
q09.text: 课程资料能够在本地打开，并不表示可以把整份文件发送给外部模型。上传前应确认资料使用权限，并避免把学生姓名、成绩或不必要的个人信息混入检索片段。检索时需要限定当前课程和允许使用的文件，不能因为其他课程的文本相似就跨越访问边界。给模型的上下文应只包含完成任务所需的片段，同时保留所选来源的可追溯记录。索引、模型调用记录和教师导出材料也可能包含原文，因而需要相应的保存与访问安排。内容脱敏和课程隔离属于数据管理要求，不能用较高的检索分数或流畅的生成答案代替。

q09.title: 页缓存、写入返回与持久化
q09.text: 应用调用写入操作后，数据可能先进入操作系统页缓存，随后才由系统安排写到设备。写入返回成功因此不总是代表突然断电后数据仍然存在。需要更强持久化保证的程序，应按照平台及文件系统的语义使用适当的同步操作，并考虑文件内容与目录元数据更新之间的关系。缓存改善平均读写效率，却也使应用观察到的完成时间和实际稳定存储时间不同。数据库日志的持久化要求最终仍需要下层存储配合。测试持久化时应说明故障类型和存储假设，不能用进程正常退出的一次试验代替所有崩溃与掉电场景。

q10.title: Blocking work inside an asynchronous event loop
q10.text: An asynchronous event loop can serve many tasks efficiently when they frequently wait for input or output and yield control while waiting. Declaring a function asynchronous does not make long computation disappear or automatically assign it to another core. If a callback performs a long CPU-bound calculation without yielding, other callbacks on that loop must wait, increasing response latency even when they do little work themselves. Moving suitable blocking work to a bounded worker pool or separate processes can help, but introduces scheduling and communication costs. Evaluate waiting time and compute time separately. The number of concurrent requests is not the same as the amount of computation that can execute in parallel.

q10.title: Recursive resolvers and authoritative DNS servers
q10.text: A client commonly sends a domain-name question to a recursive resolver and expects a completed answer or a failure. The resolver follows referrals through the DNS hierarchy when it lacks a usable cached answer. An authoritative server is responsible for the records in a particular zone; it does not need to perform every client's complete recursive lookup. Caches let resolvers answer some questions without contacting the authoritative server on every request. These roles can exist in different services, although software may support several roles. A failure at the resolver, an incorrect zone record, and an expired delegation are different operational problems. Investigating them requires identifying which stage produced the unexpected answer.

q10.title: TLS identity and application authorization
q10.text: TLS protects data in transit and can authenticate the server name through certificate validation under an appropriate trust model. A browser accepting the server certificate is not proof that the person using the browser may read every record hosted by that server. The application still needs authentication, session handling, and authorization checks for protected actions or data. TLS also does not repair unsafe database queries or remove personal information already placed in a response. When a reverse proxy terminates TLS, the connection from that proxy to the application is a separate transport segment whose protection must be considered. Transport security and application access policy solve different problems.

q10.title: Lexical retrieval with BM25
q10.text: BM25 ranks passages using the query terms that also occur in each passage. A term appearing in fewer documents can provide a stronger discrimination signal than a common term. Term frequency has a saturating effect, while document-length normalization limits the advantage of long passages that contain many words. Tokenization determines what counts as a matching term, which matters for identifiers, abbreviations, and Chinese text without spaces. BM25 does not automatically translate an English query into Chinese or recognize every paraphrase. Its score is a ranking value tied to the collection and scoring formula, not a calibrated probability of relevance. Exact terminology can help lexical retrieval even when a dense model misses a specialized phrase.

q10.title: Shared web caches and personalized responses
q10.text: A CDN or shared proxy may reuse one stored response for multiple clients when the response's cache policy allows that reuse. This is useful for public images and other reusable content, but dangerous when the body contains information belonging to one signed-in user. A design must decide whether a response is public, restricted to a private cache, or unsuitable for storage. Cache-Control directives and correctly selected cache-key dimensions help express that policy; adding a cookie alone should not be treated as a universal guarantee that no shared cache will reuse the response. Content freshness and user separation are distinct concerns, so making a private page fresh does not make sharing it safe.

q10.title: Concurrent updates and transaction isolation
q10.text: Two transactions can read the same available-seat count before either updates it. If both compute a new value from that stale read, one update may overwrite the other, or both students may believe the final seat was reserved. Transaction isolation determines which concurrent interactions are allowed; it is distinct from grouping operations into an atomic unit. Depending on the database, an atomic conditional update, appropriate locking, or a serializable transaction can protect this operation. Applications may still need to retry transactions aborted by a concurrency conflict. A correct design states the invariant, the database guarantees it relies on, and how conflicts are handled, rather than assuming that merely opening a transaction prevents every race.

q10.title: Denormalization and materialized summaries
q10.text: A reporting page may repeatedly join enrollment, course, and department tables to show a summary that changes less often than it is read. A materialized view or maintained summary table stores a derived result so later reads can do less work. This exchanges read-time computation for storage, refresh work, and a freshness decision. An immediate maintenance strategy adds cost to writes, while a scheduled refresh can temporarily show stale information. The design must specify which table is authoritative and how derived data is rebuilt after an error. Denormalization is a deliberate performance choice, not evidence that normalization was unnecessary or that duplicated facts will stay consistent automatically.

q10.title: Replication is different from a recoverable backup
q10.text: Replication maintains another database copy so a service can continue when one machine becomes unavailable. It can also copy a mistaken deletion or corrupted application update, because those changes may look like ordinary valid transactions. A backup preserves a recoverable earlier state, and its usefulness depends on retention, integrity, restore procedures, and where it is stored. Asynchronous replication may lag, so failover can also involve a recovery-point tradeoff. The recovery point objective concerns acceptable data loss, whereas the recovery time objective concerns how long restoration may take. Neither objective is satisfied simply by counting replicas. Test restoration and document which failures each mechanism actually covers.

q10.title: Open file descriptors and unlinking a name
q10.text: In a Unix-like file system, a file descriptor refers to an open file description rather than merely remembering a pathname for each operation. Removing a directory entry with unlink removes that name, but an already open descriptor may continue to access the file's contents until the remaining references are released. This explains why a process can keep writing to a file that no longer appears under the old name, and why disk space may not be reclaimed immediately. Closing a descriptor releases that process's reference; other descriptors or names can still keep the underlying file alive. Path lookup, open handles, and storage lifetime are related but distinct concepts.

q10.title: Counting semaphores for bounded queues
q10.text: A counting semaphore represents a number of available permits. A bounded queue can use one semaphore for free slots and another for stored items: producers obtain a slot permit before adding an item, while consumers obtain an item permit before removing one. A separate mutex is still commonly used to protect the queue's internal data structure. Unlike a condition-variable notification, a released semaphore permit remains available to a later waiter until it is acquired. Operations must be ordered carefully so a thread does not hold the queue mutex while waiting for a permit that another thread needs that mutex to release. Permits represent availability; they do not automatically make arbitrary shared data updates atomic.

q11.title: TCP字节流与应用消息边界
q11.text: TCP向应用提供可靠、有序的字节流，负责按序交付数据并在需要时重传，但它不会保留每次应用写入的消息边界。发送方连续写入两条消息，接收方一次读取可能得到半条、完整一条，或者多条消息拼在一起。因此应用协议应使用长度字段、分隔符或其他明确的分帧规则，并正确处理多次读取。接收窗口帮助发送方避免压垮接收端缓冲区，但字节成功送达不代表业务请求已经被处理，更不代表重试请求天然不会重复执行。TCP的传输可靠性和应用层消息语义应分开设计。

q11.title: 反向代理的入口与后端路由
q11.text: 反向代理作为客户端看到的服务入口，接收请求后根据主机名、路径或负载策略转发到内部应用。这样可以把多个后端组织在同一个外部入口后面，并集中处理部分连接管理工作。代理能够终止外部TLS连接，但代理到后端仍是另一段通信，需要单独考虑保护。代理转发请求不等于已经完成每个应用的用户权限检查，也不会自动让私有网络中的入口从公网可达。排查故障时应分开检查公网到入口的可达性、代理的路由配置和后端服务响应，不能仅凭代理进程正在运行就认定整个访问链路可用。

q11.title: HTTP缓存的新鲜度与再验证
q11.text: HTTP缓存可以在响应仍然新鲜时直接复用它，减少传输和服务器工作。Cache-Control中的max-age表达新鲜度期限；过期并不一定需要重新下载整个资源。缓存可携带ETag发送条件请求，如果服务器确认内容未改变，可以返回304状态，让客户端继续使用已有正文。ETag标识的是资源表示的验证信息，不是用户身份令牌。缓存策略还要考虑响应是否包含个人内容，以及共享缓存是否允许保存它。DNS缓存、浏览器缓存和中间共享缓存处理的对象不同，不能因为域名地址未改变，就推断网页正文也无需更新。

q11.title: 预写日志与故障恢复
q11.text: 数据库在修改后的数据页尚未全部落盘时也可能返回提交成功，因此需要一个明确的持久化协议。预写日志要求相关日志记录先于对应数据页持久保存；恢复过程利用日志重做需要保留的已提交修改，并按照具体恢复算法处理未完成事务。检查点可以缩短恢复时需要检查的日志范围，但检查点不是脱离日志也能保证所有历史修改安全的承诺。是否等待日志真正持久化会影响提交后的故障保证。预写日志主要服务于崩溃恢复，不能单独防止管理员合法提交一条误删除语句，也不能替代独立保存并经过恢复演练的备份。

q11.title: 死锁条件与统一加锁顺序
q11.text: 两个线程分别持有对方接下来需要的锁，并且都等待对方释放时，就可能永久停止推进。经典死锁分析讨论互斥、占有并等待、不可抢占和循环等待等必要条件。为所有相关锁规定一致的获取顺序，可以破坏循环等待：线程不能一会儿先拿甲再拿乙，另一处却先拿乙再拿甲。这个规则必须覆盖实际共享资源的获取路径，局部遵守不足以保证全局安全。超时可以帮助检测或脱离某些等待，却不自动提供正确的恢复语义。避免死锁也不同于避免饥饿，线程仍可能长期抢不到执行机会。

q11.title: 拥塞控制与接收端流量控制
q11.text: 发送速度受到两个不同方向的约束。接收端流量控制考虑对方还有多少缓冲空间，避免发送方把接收端来不及处理的数据堆满；网络拥塞控制则考虑路径上的链路和路由器承受能力，试图避免持续排队和丢包恶化。接收端有很大的缓冲区，并不意味着网络中间链路同样空闲；反过来，网络畅通也不保证接收应用足够快。TCP会结合相关窗口限制可在途的数据量。分析吞吐下降时，需要区分接收窗口限制、丢包与拥塞响应，以及应用自身读取缓慢，而不是统一归因于带宽不足。

q11.text: 如果每条选课记录都重复保存教师办公室，当教师搬迁时就需要修改多行；漏改其中一行会让同一个事实出现不同版本。规范化通过分析属性之间的函数依赖，把属于不同实体的事实放到合适的关系中，减少这类更新异常。第三范式的讨论关注非平凡函数依赖的决定因素和属性角色，实际设计时应先明确键与业务含义，而不是只按列数拆表。分解后通常需要连接才能恢复完整查询结果。规范化改善的是数据事实的组织与一致性风险，并不保证所有查询更快，也不会替代外键、唯一性等可执行约束。

q12.title: Concurrent updates and transaction isolation
q12.text: Two transactions can read the same available-seat count before either updates it. If both compute a new value from that stale read, one update may overwrite the other, or both students may believe the final seat was reserved. Transaction isolation determines which concurrent interactions are allowed; it is distinct from grouping operations into an atomic unit. Depending on the database, an atomic conditional update, appropriate locking, or a serializable transaction can protect this operation. Applications may still need to retry transactions aborted by a concurrency conflict. A correct design states the invariant, the database guarantees it relies on, and how conflicts are handled, rather than assuming that merely opening a transaction prevents every race.

q12.title: Shared web caches and personalized responses
q12.text: A CDN or shared proxy may reuse one stored response for multiple clients when the response's cache policy allows that reuse. This is useful for public images and other reusable content, but dangerous when the body contains information belonging to one signed-in user. A design must decide whether a response is public, restricted to a private cache, or unsuitable for storage. Cache-Control directives and correctly selected cache-key dimensions help express that policy; adding a cookie alone should not be treated as a universal guarantee that no shared cache will reuse the response. Content freshness and user separation are distinct concerns, so making a private page fresh does not make sharing it safe.

q12.title: Keys, uniqueness, and referential integrity
q12.text: A primary key identifies each row and must be unique and non-null. A foreign key constrains a reference to an existing key in another table, subject to the database and constraint definition. An enrollment table can use a composite uniqueness constraint on student and course so the same pair is not recorded twice. These constraints express different invariants: a foreign key does not itself prevent repeated enrollment, and a unique key does not ensure that the referenced course exists. Applications should also decide what should happen when a referenced row is deleted. Constraints are enforced rules, while an informal convention in application code may be bypassed by another writer.

q12.title: Leading columns in a composite index
q12.text: A composite index on department and enrollment year is ordered first by department and then by year within each department. Predicates on the leading department column can use that ordering directly, and specifying both columns can narrow the matching range further. A predicate on year alone does not have the same straightforward left-prefix access path because equal years are scattered among departments. Some database engines can use other access strategies, so this is not an absolute claim that the index can never help. Index column order should follow actual predicates, ordering requirements, and measured plans. Creating both possible column orders also increases storage and write-maintenance costs.

q12.title: Evaluating retrieval for questions needing several sources
q12.text: A question may require several independent facts, such as a definition, a boundary condition, and a worked example. Finding one relevant passage can give a good reciprocal-rank score while still leaving the question impossible to answer completely. Annotate the necessary evidence groups before inspecting system rankings. If two passages are interchangeable support for the same fact, place them in one group rather than requiring both. Evidence coverage measures how many groups are represented in the retrieved set; complete-evidence success requires every group. Passage recall remains a different measure because it counts individual relevant passages, including alternatives. Relevance labels require review, and an assistant-authored pilot collection should not be represented as an independently validated gold standard.

q12.title: Scheduling and context-switch overhead
q12.text: A scheduler chooses which runnable thread gets a processor. On one available core, switching rapidly between runnable tasks creates concurrency, but only one of those tasks executes on that core at a particular instant. Multiple cores can provide parallel execution when the workload and runtime allow it. A context switch saves and restores execution state and can disrupt useful cache contents, so excessively frequent switching may reduce throughput. A blocked thread is different from a runnable one waiting for its turn: it cannot make progress until its awaited event occurs. The best number of workers depends on compute demand, waiting time, available cores, and coordination cost, not merely the number of tasks submitted.

q12.title: Virtual addresses and page-fault handling
q12.text: A process uses virtual addresses that are translated through page tables into physical memory locations. A page fault means the requested translation or access cannot be completed in the current state; it does not always mean the program has a bug or that disk input is required. A valid demand-zero page may be allocated on first use, a file-backed page may need loading, or an invalid access may cause the process to receive a fault signal. The operating system checks the mapping and permissions before deciding which action is appropriate. When physical frames are scarce, replacement decisions can evict pages, making future valid accesses fault again. Address validity and current physical residency are different properties.

q12.title: Diversity-aware reranking with MMR
q12.text: Maximal Marginal Relevance selects results iteratively by balancing relevance to the query against similarity to already selected results. A passage that is highly relevant but almost duplicates an earlier selection may lose to a somewhat lower-ranked passage containing complementary information. A weighting parameter controls this tradeoff. The method can reduce redundant context, but it can also discard similar-looking passages that provide distinct conditions or exceptions required by the question. Similarity is therefore only a proxy for redundancy. Keep the candidate pool and relevance score definition explicit when comparing the method with an unreordered ranking. More varied results are not automatically better evidence, and relevance or evidence coverage may decrease.

q12.title: Lexical retrieval with BM25
q12.text: BM25 ranks passages using the query terms that also occur in each passage. A term appearing in fewer documents can provide a stronger discrimination signal than a common term. Term frequency has a saturating effect, while document-length normalization limits the advantage of long passages that contain many words. Tokenization determines what counts as a matching term, which matters for identifiers, abbreviations, and Chinese text without spaces. BM25 does not automatically translate an English query into Chinese or recognize every paraphrase. Its score is a ranking value tied to the collection and scoring formula, not a calibrated probability of relevance. Exact terminology can help lexical retrieval even when a dense model misses a specialized phrase.

q13.title: 引用存在与证据支持
q13.text: 教学系统给答案附上片段编号，只能说明它引用了一个可定位的来源，不能证明该来源支持答案。审核者需要把答案中的实质性判断逐项对照原文，检查是否遗漏限制条件、把相关关系写成因果关系，或者引用了同一主题却没有回答问题的段落。程序可以检查编号是否属于本次检索集合，但这样的结构检查不能替代内容判断。导出材料时保存引用片段的文本快照及来源位置，有助于在讲义或索引更新后重现当时依据。没有支持的结论应标明并修订，而不是为了让页面看起来完整而添加一个无关引用。

q13.title: 课程讲义的分块边界
q13.text: 把课程讲义切成检索片段时，应尽量保留一个完整的解释单位。例如定理的假设、结论和紧接着的反例如果被分到互不相邻的小块，系统可能只取回结论，让学生误以为它无条件成立。按标题或段落切分通常比机械截断更容易保留结构，但过长的片段又会夹入无关内容。少量重叠可以保留边界附近的上下文，代价是相邻检索结果更容易重复。每个片段仍应记录原文件及页码，便于教师返回上下文核对。分块策略应和问题类型一起评估，不能仅凭片段越短或越长就推断效果更好。

q13.title: 规范化与更新异常
q13.text: 如果每条选课记录都重复保存教师办公室，当教师搬迁时就需要修改多行；漏改其中一行会让同一个事实出现不同版本。规范化通过分析属性之间的函数依赖，把属于不同实体的事实放到合适的关系中，减少这类更新异常。第三范式的讨论关注非平凡函数依赖的决定因素和属性角色，实际设计时应先明确键与业务含义，而不是只按列数拆表。分解后通常需要连接才能恢复完整查询结果。规范化改善的是数据事实的组织与一致性风险，并不保证所有查询更快，也不会替代外键、唯一性等可执行约束。

q13.title: B+树索引和范围查询
q13.text: B+树索引按键值有序组织查找入口，因此既能定位某个键，也能沿有序叶结点访问连续范围。例如按时间查找某一周的订单，比逐行检查整张表更有机会减少访问量。但索引并非免费的副本：插入、删除和相关列更新都需要维护索引结构，并占用额外空间。如果条件会返回表中很大一部分记录，逐个通过索引回到数据页的成本可能高于顺序扫描。是否使用索引由查询优化器估算，不能把存在索引等同于一定走索引。这里讨论的是有序检索能力，不能由此推断索引能够自动解决并发更新冲突。

q13.title: 课程资料权限与最小发送范围
q13.text: 课程资料能够在本地打开，并不表示可以把整份文件发送给外部模型。上传前应确认资料使用权限，并避免把学生姓名、成绩或不必要的个人信息混入检索片段。检索时需要限定当前课程和允许使用的文件，不能因为其他课程的文本相似就跨越访问边界。给模型的上下文应只包含完成任务所需的片段，同时保留所选来源的可追溯记录。索引、模型调用记录和教师导出材料也可能包含原文，因而需要相应的保存与访问安排。内容脱敏和课程隔离属于数据管理要求，不能用较高的检索分数或流畅的生成答案代替。

q13.title: 检索数量与上下文预算
q13.text: 增加送给生成模型的片段数量，可能让遗漏的证据进入上下文，也可能把更多近主题干扰一起带入。假如一道题需要定义和适用条件两部分依据，只取一个片段可能不够；如果前五个结果都是同一段解释的轻微改写，增加数量也未必带来新的必要信息。因此需要同时观察相关片段覆盖、必要证据是否齐全以及上下文中的无关内容。相似度排名不是答案正确的概率，也不能单独决定资料是否足够。检索数量应在固定任务和上下文预算下比较，记录哪些问题受益、哪些问题退步，不能默认更多片段总会改善教学答案。

q13.title: 死锁条件与统一加锁顺序
q13.text: 两个线程分别持有对方接下来需要的锁，并且都等待对方释放时，就可能永久停止推进。经典死锁分析讨论互斥、占有并等待、不可抢占和循环等待等必要条件。为所有相关锁规定一致的获取顺序，可以破坏循环等待：线程不能一会儿先拿甲再拿乙，另一处却先拿乙再拿甲。这个规则必须覆盖实际共享资源的获取路径，局部遵守不足以保证全局安全。超时可以帮助检测或脱离某些等待，却不自动提供正确的恢复语义。避免死锁也不同于避免饥饿，线程仍可能长期抢不到执行机会。

q13.title: 反向代理的入口与后端路由
q13.text: 反向代理作为客户端看到的服务入口，接收请求后根据主机名、路径或负载策略转发到内部应用。这样可以把多个后端组织在同一个外部入口后面，并集中处理部分连接管理工作。代理能够终止外部TLS连接，但代理到后端仍是另一段通信，需要单独考虑保护。代理转发请求不等于已经完成每个应用的用户权限检查，也不会自动让私有网络中的入口从公网可达。排查故障时应分开检查公网到入口的可达性、代理的路由配置和后端服务响应，不能仅凭代理进程正在运行就认定整个访问链路可用。

q13.title: 用倒数排名融合检索结果
q13.text: 关键词检索和向量检索提供不同的匹配信号，直接相加它们的原始分数可能受到量纲和分布差异影响。倒数排名融合为每一路结果中的文档按名次计算贡献，再把同一文档的贡献相加。常见形式为各路一除以常数加名次之和，名次从一开始；未进入某一路候选列表的文档不获得该路贡献。这样可以结合两种排序，而不要求两路分数可比较。融合仍受候选池限制：两路都没有召回的片段不会凭空出现。参数、候选数量和同分处理规则应固定记录；融合是一种待验证方法，不能仅凭加入两路检索就宣称一定优于单路。

q13.title: 预写日志与故障恢复
q13.text: 数据库在修改后的数据页尚未全部落盘时也可能返回提交成功，因此需要一个明确的持久化协议。预写日志要求相关日志记录先于对应数据页持久保存；恢复过程利用日志重做需要保留的已提交修改，并按照具体恢复算法处理未完成事务。检查点可以缩短恢复时需要检查的日志范围，但检查点不是脱离日志也能保证所有历史修改安全的承诺。是否等待日志真正持久化会影响提交后的故障保证。预写日志主要服务于崩溃恢复，不能单独防止管理员合法提交一条误删除语句，也不能替代独立保存并经过恢复演练的备份。

q14.title: UDP and delay-sensitive applications
q14.text: UDP sends datagrams and preserves their boundaries, but it does not provide TCP-style reliable ordered delivery. A receiver may observe loss, duplication, or reordering, and an oversized datagram can create additional delivery problems. Interactive audio may prefer receiving a recent sample promptly to waiting for retransmission of an old sample whose playback deadline has passed. That choice does not make all reliability unnecessary: an application can add sequence numbers, jitter buffering, selective recovery, and congestion-sensitive sending. File transfer has different requirements because missing bytes usually must be recovered. Choosing UDP changes which responsibilities the application must handle; it does not guarantee low delay or solve network congestion by itself.

q14.title: Open file descriptors and unlinking a name
q14.text: In a Unix-like file system, a file descriptor refers to an open file description rather than merely remembering a pathname for each operation. Removing a directory entry with unlink removes that name, but an already open descriptor may continue to access the file's contents until the remaining references are released. This explains why a process can keep writing to a file that no longer appears under the old name, and why disk space may not be reclaimed immediately. Closing a descriptor releases that process's reference; other descriptors or names can still keep the underlying file alive. Path lookup, open handles, and storage lifetime are related but distinct concepts.

q14.title: Address translation and incoming connections
q14.text: A home or small-office router commonly translates private IPv4 addresses and transport ports to a public-facing address. For outbound connections it keeps mappings so returning traffic can be delivered to the correct internal endpoint. An unsolicited inbound connection has no corresponding mapping by default in this common setup; exposing an internal service usually requires an explicit forwarding rule or another connectivity mechanism. Address translation is not application authentication, and forwarding a port does not encrypt its traffic. A reverse proxy can provide an application entry point, but the network path to that proxy must still be reachable. State the address, port, and forwarding assumptions when diagnosing connectivity.

q14.text: Replication maintains another database copy so a service can continue when one machine becomes unavailable. It can also copy a mistaken deletion or corrupted application update, because those changes may look like ordinary valid transactions. A backup preserves a recoverable earlier state, and its usefulness depends on retention, integrity, restore procedures, and where it is stored. Asynchronous replication may lag, so failover can also involve a recovery-point tradeoff. The recovery point objective concerns acceptable data loss, whereas the recovery time objective concerns how long restoration may take. Neither objective is satisfied simply by counting replicas. Test restoration and document which failures each mechanism actually covers.

q14.text: A document index and its incoming queries must use compatible embedding spaces. Matching vector dimensions are necessary for computing a dot product, but they do not establish that two models assign the same meaning to each coordinate. Replacing the model while retaining old document vectors can therefore produce numerically valid yet meaningless similarity scores. Record the provider, model name, preprocessing settings, and embedding parameters with the index. After a material configuration change, regenerate document embeddings and use the same configuration for new queries. Normalize vectors consistently when cosine similarity is intended. An unchanged product name is not proof that an upstream model has never changed, so preserve configuration records and regression examples.

q14.text: A client commonly sends a domain-name question to a recursive resolver and expects a completed answer or a failure. The resolver follows referrals through the DNS hierarchy when it lacks a usable cached answer. An authoritative server is responsible for the records in a particular zone; it does not need to perform every client's complete recursive lookup. Caches let resolvers answer some questions without contacting the authoritative server on every request. These roles can exist in different services, although software may support several roles. A failure at the resolver, an incorrect zone record, and an expired delegation are different operational problems. Investigating them requires identifying which stage produced the unexpected answer.

q14.text: TLS protects data in transit and can authenticate the server name through certificate validation under an appropriate trust model. A browser accepting the server certificate is not proof that the person using the browser may read every record hosted by that server. The application still needs authentication, session handling, and authorization checks for protected actions or data. TLS also does not repair unsafe database queries or remove personal information already placed in a response. When a reverse proxy terminates TLS, the connection from that proxy to the application is a separate transport segment whose protection must be considered. Transport security and application access policy solve different problems.

q15.text: A course-grounded answer can fail at several different stages. The uploaded collection may contain no evidence for the question, the retriever may miss evidence that is present, or the generator may ignore or distort passages that were successfully retrieved. These cases require different diagnoses. Inspect the collection and retrieved passages before changing the generation prompt. A retrieval metric measures whether relevant passages were found; it does not establish whether the final explanation used them faithfully. Conversely, an incorrect generated answer does not by itself prove the retriever failed. Keep the query, source collection version, ranked candidates, selected context, and generated answer so the stages can be inspected separately.

q15.text: An asynchronous event loop can serve many tasks efficiently when they frequently wait for input or output and yield control while waiting. Declaring a function asynchronous does not make long computation disappear or automatically assign it to another core. If a callback performs a long CPU-bound calculation without yielding, other callbacks on that loop must wait, increasing response latency even when they do little work themselves. Moving suitable blocking work to a bounded worker pool or separate processes can help, but introduces scheduling and communication costs. Evaluate waiting time and compute time separately. The number of concurrent requests is not the same as the amount of computation that can execute in parallel.

q15.title: Denormalization and materialized summaries
q15.text: A reporting page may repeatedly join enrollment, course, and department tables to show a summary that changes less often than it is read. A materialized view or maintained summary table stores a derived result so later reads can do less work. This exchanges read-time computation for storage, refresh work, and a freshness decision. An immediate maintenance strategy adds cost to writes, while a scheduled refresh can temporarily show stale information. The design must specify which table is authoritative and how derived data is rebuilt after an error. Denormalization is a deliberate performance choice, not evidence that normalization was unnecessary or that duplicated facts will stay consistent automatically.

q16.title: 检索数量与上下文预算
q16.text: 增加送给生成模型的片段数量，可能让遗漏的证据进入上下文，也可能把更多近主题干扰一起带入。假如一道题需要定义和适用条件两部分依据，只取一个片段可能不够；如果前五个结果都是同一段解释的轻微改写，增加数量也未必带来新的必要信息。因此需要同时观察相关片段覆盖、必要证据是否齐全以及上下文中的无关内容。相似度排名不是答案正确的概率，也不能单独决定资料是否足够。检索数量应在固定任务和上下文预算下比较，记录哪些问题受益、哪些问题退步，不能默认更多片段总会改善教学答案。

q16.title: B+树索引和范围查询
q16.text: B+树索引按键值有序组织查找入口，因此既能定位某个键，也能沿有序叶结点访问连续范围。例如按时间查找某一周的订单，比逐行检查整张表更有机会减少访问量。但索引并非免费的副本：插入、删除和相关列更新都需要维护索引结构，并占用额外空间。如果条件会返回表中很大一部分记录，逐个通过索引回到数据页的成本可能高于顺序扫描。是否使用索引由查询优化器估算，不能把存在索引等同于一定走索引。这里讨论的是有序检索能力，不能由此推断索引能够自动解决并发更新冲突。

q16.title: 引用存在与证据支持
q16.text: 教学系统给答案附上片段编号，只能说明它引用了一个可定位的来源，不能证明该来源支持答案。审核者需要把答案中的实质性判断逐项对照原文，检查是否遗漏限制条件、把相关关系写成因果关系，或者引用了同一主题却没有回答问题的段落。程序可以检查编号是否属于本次检索集合，但这样的结构检查不能替代内容判断。导出材料时保存引用片段的文本快照及来源位置，有助于在讲义或索引更新后重现当时依据。没有支持的结论应标明并修订，而不是为了让页面看起来完整而添加一个无关引用。

q16.title: 课程资料权限与最小发送范围
q16.text: 课程资料能够在本地打开，并不表示可以把整份文件发送给外部模型。上传前应确认资料使用权限，并避免把学生姓名、成绩或不必要的个人信息混入检索片段。检索时需要限定当前课程和允许使用的文件，不能因为其他课程的文本相似就跨越访问边界。给模型的上下文应只包含完成任务所需的片段，同时保留所选来源的可追溯记录。索引、模型调用记录和教师导出材料也可能包含原文，因而需要相应的保存与访问安排。内容脱敏和课程隔离属于数据管理要求，不能用较高的检索分数或流畅的生成答案代替。

q16.title: 页缓存、写入返回与持久化
q16.text: 应用调用写入操作后，数据可能先进入操作系统页缓存，随后才由系统安排写到设备。写入返回成功因此不总是代表突然断电后数据仍然存在。需要更强持久化保证的程序，应按照平台及文件系统的语义使用适当的同步操作，并考虑文件内容与目录元数据更新之间的关系。缓存改善平均读写效率，却也使应用观察到的完成时间和实际稳定存储时间不同。数据库日志的持久化要求最终仍需要下层存储配合。测试持久化时应说明故障类型和存储假设，不能用进程正常退出的一次试验代替所有崩溃与掉电场景。

q16.title: 用倒数排名融合检索结果
q16.text: 关键词检索和向量检索提供不同的匹配信号，直接相加它们的原始分数可能受到量纲和分布差异影响。倒数排名融合为每一路结果中的文档按名次计算贡献，再把同一文档的贡献相加。常见形式为各路一除以常数加名次之和，名次从一开始；未进入某一路候选列表的文档不获得该路贡献。这样可以结合两种排序，而不要求两路分数可比较。融合仍受候选池限制：两路都没有召回的片段不会凭空出现。参数、候选数量和同分处理规则应固定记录；融合是一种待验证方法，不能仅凭加入两路检索就宣称一定优于单路。

q16.title: HTTP缓存的新鲜度与再验证
q16.text: HTTP缓存可以在响应仍然新鲜时直接复用它，减少传输和服务器工作。Cache-Control中的max-age表达新鲜度期限；过期并不一定需要重新下载整个资源。缓存可携带ETag发送条件请求，如果服务器确认内容未改变，可以返回304状态，让客户端继续使用已有正文。ETag标识的是资源表示的验证信息，不是用户身份令牌。缓存策略还要考虑响应是否包含个人内容，以及共享缓存是否允许保存它。DNS缓存、浏览器缓存和中间共享缓存处理的对象不同，不能因为域名地址未改变，就推断网页正文也无需更新。

q16.title: 互斥锁与条件变量的队列模式
q16.text: 有界任务队列需要同时保护共享数据和协调等待条件。互斥锁保证队列状态在检查和修改时不会被其他线程同时破坏；条件变量让线程在队列为空或已满时等待状态变化，而不是不断占用处理器轮询。等待条件变量通常会原子地释放相关互斥锁，线程被唤醒后再重新取得锁。被唤醒不保证所需条件此时一定成立，因为其他线程可能已先改变状态，也可能存在虚假唤醒，所以应在循环中重新检查条件。发出通知本身不保存队列元素，也不能代替保护共享状态的锁。

q16.title: 规范化与更新异常
q16.text: 如果每条选课记录都重复保存教师办公室，当教师搬迁时就需要修改多行；漏改其中一行会让同一个事实出现不同版本。规范化通过分析属性之间的函数依赖，把属于不同实体的事实放到合适的关系中，减少这类更新异常。第三范式的讨论关注非平凡函数依赖的决定因素和属性角色，实际设计时应先明确键与业务含义，而不是只按列数拆表。分解后通常需要连接才能恢复完整查询结果。规范化改善的是数据事实的组织与一致性风险，并不保证所有查询更快，也不会替代外键、唯一性等可执行约束。

q16.title: DNS缓存与TTL
q16.text: 域名解析结果可以缓存在递归解析器和客户端中，避免每次访问都重新向权威服务器查询。资源记录的生存时间规定这份缓存通常还能复用多久；到期后，解析器需要按相应解析过程重新获取结果，而不是永远相信旧地址。修改权威记录不会瞬间清除互联网上已有的缓存，所以用户可能在一段时间内访问到不同地址。缩短生存时间通常有利于更快看到变更，但会增加查询负担。域名缓存只负责名称到记录的解析，不等于浏览器已经缓存网页内容，也不负责验证网页用户是否拥有访问权限。

q17.title: Concurrent updates and transaction isolation
q17.text: Two transactions can read the same available-seat count before either updates it. If both compute a new value from that stale read, one update may overwrite the other, or both students may believe the final seat was reserved. Transaction isolation determines which concurrent interactions are allowed; it is distinct from grouping operations into an atomic unit. Depending on the database, an atomic conditional update, appropriate locking, or a serializable transaction can protect this operation. Applications may still need to retry transactions aborted by a concurrency conflict. A correct design states the invariant, the database guarantees it relies on, and how conflicts are handled, rather than assuming that merely opening a transaction prevents every race.

q17.title: Keys, uniqueness, and referential integrity
q17.text: A primary key identifies each row and must be unique and non-null. A foreign key constrains a reference to an existing key in another table, subject to the database and constraint definition. An enrollment table can use a composite uniqueness constraint on student and course so the same pair is not recorded twice. These constraints express different invariants: a foreign key does not itself prevent repeated enrollment, and a unique key does not ensure that the referenced course exists. Applications should also decide what should happen when a referenced row is deleted. Constraints are enforced rules, while an informal convention in application code may be bypassed by another writer.

q17.title: Counting semaphores for bounded queues
q17.text: A counting semaphore represents a number of available permits. A bounded queue can use one semaphore for free slots and another for stored items: producers obtain a slot permit before adding an item, while consumers obtain an item permit before removing one. A separate mutex is still commonly used to protect the queue's internal data structure. Unlike a condition-variable notification, a released semaphore permit remains available to a later waiter until it is acquired. Operations must be ordered carefully so a thread does not hold the queue mutex while waiting for a permit that another thread needs that mutex to release. Permits represent availability; they do not automatically make arbitrary shared data updates atomic.

q17.title: Scheduling and context-switch overhead
q17.text: A scheduler chooses which runnable thread gets a processor. On one available core, switching rapidly between runnable tasks creates concurrency, but only one of those tasks executes on that core at a particular instant. Multiple cores can provide parallel execution when the workload and runtime allow it. A context switch saves and restores execution state and can disrupt useful cache contents, so excessively frequent switching may reduce throughput. A blocked thread is different from a runnable one waiting for its turn: it cannot make progress until its awaited event occurs. The best number of workers depends on compute demand, waiting time, available cores, and coordination cost, not merely the number of tasks submitted.

q17.title: Virtual addresses and page-fault handling
q17.text: A process uses virtual addresses that are translated through page tables into physical memory locations. A page fault means the requested translation or access cannot be completed in the current state; it does not always mean the program has a bug or that disk input is required. A valid demand-zero page may be allocated on first use, a file-backed page may need loading, or an invalid access may cause the process to receive a fault signal. The operating system checks the mapping and permissions before deciding which action is appropriate. When physical frames are scarce, replacement decisions can evict pages, making future valid accesses fault again. Address validity and current physical residency are different properties.

q17.title: Leading columns in a composite index
q17.text: A composite index on department and enrollment year is ordered first by department and then by year within each department. Predicates on the leading department column can use that ordering directly, and specifying both columns can narrow the matching range further. A predicate on year alone does not have the same straightforward left-prefix access path because equal years are scattered among departments. Some database engines can use other access strategies, so this is not an absolute claim that the index can never help. Index column order should follow actual predicates, ordering requirements, and measured plans. Creating both possible column orders also increases storage and write-maintenance costs.

q17.title: Open file descriptors and unlinking a name
q17.text: In a Unix-like file system, a file descriptor refers to an open file description rather than merely remembering a pathname for each operation. Removing a directory entry with unlink removes that name, but an already open descriptor may continue to access the file's contents until the remaining references are released. This explains why a process can keep writing to a file that no longer appears under the old name, and why disk space may not be reclaimed immediately. Closing a descriptor releases that process's reference; other descriptors or names can still keep the underlying file alive. Path lookup, open handles, and storage lifetime are related but distinct concepts.

q17.title: Recursive resolvers and authoritative DNS servers
q17.text: A client commonly sends a domain-name question to a recursive resolver and expects a completed answer or a failure. The resolver follows referrals through the DNS hierarchy when it lacks a usable cached answer. An authoritative server is responsible for the records in a particular zone; it does not need to perform every client's complete recursive lookup. Caches let resolvers answer some questions without contacting the authoritative server on every request. These roles can exist in different services, although software may support several roles. A failure at the resolver, an incorrect zone record, and an expired delegation are different operational problems. Investigating them requires identifying which stage produced the unexpected answer.

q17.title: Embedding configuration and index compatibility
q17.text: A document index and its incoming queries must use compatible embedding spaces. Matching vector dimensions are necessary for computing a dot product, but they do not establish that two models assign the same meaning to each coordinate. Replacing the model while retaining old document vectors can therefore produce numerically valid yet meaningless similarity scores. Record the provider, model name, preprocessing settings, and embedding parameters with the index. After a material configuration change, regenerate document embeddings and use the same configuration for new queries. Normalize vectors consistently when cosine similarity is intended. An unchanged product name is not proof that an upstream model has never changed, so preserve configuration records and regression examples.

q17.title: Address translation and incoming connections
q17.text: A home or small-office router commonly translates private IPv4 addresses and transport ports to a public-facing address. For outbound connections it keeps mappings so returning traffic can be delivered to the correct internal endpoint. An unsolicited inbound connection has no corresponding mapping by default in this common setup; exposing an internal service usually requires an explicit forwarding rule or another connectivity mechanism. Address translation is not application authentication, and forwarding a port does not encrypt its traffic. A reverse proxy can provide an application entry point, but the network path to that proxy must still be reachable. State the address, port, and forwarding assumptions when diagnosing connectivity.

q18.title: 规范化与更新异常
q18.text: 如果每条选课记录都重复保存教师办公室，当教师搬迁时就需要修改多行；漏改其中一行会让同一个事实出现不同版本。规范化通过分析属性之间的函数依赖，把属于不同实体的事实放到合适的关系中，减少这类更新异常。第三范式的讨论关注非平凡函数依赖的决定因素和属性角色，实际设计时应先明确键与业务含义，而不是只按列数拆表。分解后通常需要连接才能恢复完整查询结果。规范化改善的是数据事实的组织与一致性风险，并不保证所有查询更快，也不会替代外键、唯一性等可执行约束。

q18.title: 事务的原子性与提交
q18.text: 一个选课操作可能同时减少课程剩余名额并增加学生的选课记录。如果第二项修改违反约束而第一项已经生效，数据库就处于业务不允许的中间状态。事务的原子性要求这组操作作为一个整体成功，或者在失败时撤销尚未提交的修改。提交表示应用要求数据库保留该事务的结果，回滚则放弃它。原子性并不等于并发事务完全互不影响，也不意味着任何业务规则都会自动成立；约束和隔离方式仍需单独设计。讨论故障后的持久保存时，还必须区分已经提交的结果和内存中尚未提交的临时状态。

q18.title: 课程讲义的分块边界
q18.text: 把课程讲义切成检索片段时，应尽量保留一个完整的解释单位。例如定理的假设、结论和紧接着的反例如果被分到互不相邻的小块，系统可能只取回结论，让学生误以为它无条件成立。按标题或段落切分通常比机械截断更容易保留结构，但过长的片段又会夹入无关内容。少量重叠可以保留边界附近的上下文，代价是相邻检索结果更容易重复。每个片段仍应记录原文件及页码，便于教师返回上下文核对。分块策略应和问题类型一起评估，不能仅凭片段越短或越长就推断效果更好。

q18.title: 课程资料权限与最小发送范围
q18.text: 课程资料能够在本地打开，并不表示可以把整份文件发送给外部模型。上传前应确认资料使用权限，并避免把学生姓名、成绩或不必要的个人信息混入检索片段。检索时需要限定当前课程和允许使用的文件，不能因为其他课程的文本相似就跨越访问边界。给模型的上下文应只包含完成任务所需的片段，同时保留所选来源的可追溯记录。索引、模型调用记录和教师导出材料也可能包含原文，因而需要相应的保存与访问安排。内容脱敏和课程隔离属于数据管理要求，不能用较高的检索分数或流畅的生成答案代替。

q18.title: 执行计划与选择性
q18.text: 查询优化器会根据统计信息估计条件的选择性，也就是大约有多少记录满足条件。只匹配少量记录的过滤条件，可能适合先走索引再取所需行；匹配绝大多数记录时，全表顺序扫描可能更便宜。过时或不准确的统计信息会让估计偏离实际执行，导致错误的连接顺序或访问路径。分析慢查询时应同时查看估计行数、实际行数、访问方式和数据分布，并注意一次测量受到缓存状态影响。执行计划中的成本通常是优化器内部用于比较方案的估计值，不应直接当成毫秒。索引是否有效需要在具体负载下验证。

q18.title: 引用存在与证据支持
q18.text: 教学系统给答案附上片段编号，只能说明它引用了一个可定位的来源，不能证明该来源支持答案。审核者需要把答案中的实质性判断逐项对照原文，检查是否遗漏限制条件、把相关关系写成因果关系，或者引用了同一主题却没有回答问题的段落。程序可以检查编号是否属于本次检索集合，但这样的结构检查不能替代内容判断。导出材料时保存引用片段的文本快照及来源位置，有助于在讲义或索引更新后重现当时依据。没有支持的结论应标明并修订，而不是为了让页面看起来完整而添加一个无关引用。
